head.t: J&J reports real-world Varipulse Pro data and 12-month Omnypulse outcomes at APHRS 2026
head.x: Johnson & Johnson (J&J) has announced new data from the VARIPURE and Omny-IRE studies presented at the 2026 Asia Pacific Heart Rhythm Society (APHRS) annual meeting (21–24 October, Busan, South Korea). Both studies were published simultaneously in Europace and Heart Rhythm, respectively.

head.t: MHRA approves J&J's once-daily oral psoriasis pill Icotyde
head.x: The Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA) has approved icotrokinra hydrochloride (Icotyde) for moderate to severe plaque psoriasis in adults and adolescents aged 12 and over weighing at least 40kg, authorisation granted to Janssen-Cilag Limited (Johnson & Johnson) on 23…

head.t: Johnson & Johnson launches Shockwave C2 Aero Fly coronary IVL catheter in the USA
head.x: Johnson & Johnson has announced the US launch of its Shockwave C2 Aero Fly coronary intravascular lithotripsy (IVL) catheter, designed to treat a broad range of calcified coronary artery lesions.

head.t: Stryker enters soft tissue robotics with $400M investment in Cambridge-based CMR Surgical
head.x: MedTech Dive reports Stryker is investing $400 million in CMR Surgical, moving it into soft tissue surgical robotics against Johnson & Johnson and Medtronic.
